title: US States
hook: Happy Colorado Day! The data this week comes from three Wikipedia articles: List of states and territories of the United States, List of demonyms for US states and territories, and List of state and territory name etymologies of the United States. A number of past TidyTuesdays (such as 2018/2018-04-03, 2019/2019-01-29, 2020/2020-03-10, and 2022/2022-11-08 have state columns. Might joining in this state date offer any insights to those datasets?
